_what: Why the step 1 fan-out launched some, all or none of its units, priced per unit in $/ns. Written on EVERY tick — including the ticks that rent nothing — because a stale timestamp must only ever mean the tick did not run.
_rule: CLAUDE.md §6 — a thin, expensive market is a reason to PAUSE, not to pay. A hold is a correct outcome; a SILENT hold is the bug.
decision_why: ⏸ STOOD DOWN BY OPERATOR — this lane will not rent a GPU until step1-fanout-OPERATOR-HOLD.json is deleted. Reason on record: Vast has not been used in a month and this lane is not to be driven at all (trimcrae, 2026-08-26). The escalated market hold had been asking for exactly this decision since 2026-08-06 — 'price has been the BINDING constraint ... trimcrae's call now' — and the call is: stand the lane down. · paused 2026-08-26T11:35:00Z. Banked work is untouched: the commit store is continuous, so a resume re-enters at the last COMMITTED checkpoint and nothing is lost by waiting.
decision_meaning: a person paused this lane; the hold file names who, when and why. Nothing is rented until it is deleted — and reap, collect and supervision keep running
